messages:
alex: quick PSA — my home office briefly turned into a jungle and the power strip decided to take the router with it. plant photobomb + sad wifi pic: https://imgur.com/abcd1234

mira: omg 😂 which plant is that? very dramatic. did you reboot the router?

jamal: if it's flaky after a power cut sometimes the modem needs a full unplug (30s). also check the strip fuse.

alex: unplugged for 45s, ran `ping -c 8 1.1.1.1` — seeing intermittent timeouts, like 0/8 then 5/8. ISP chat says maintenance in my block.

sasha: interim fix: tether to phone? might get you through calls.

alex: tethered now — latency ~80ms, ok for chat but rough for live demos. would like to avoid buying a second router right away.

oliver: for UPS/clean power: APC Back-UPS 600 is small and cheap. smart plug + remote power cycle is a lifesaver.

jamal: also check client list on the router, sometimes a rogue device starts torrenting. `iftop` or router UI helps.

ops-bot: Reminder: if this causes oncall impact, run `redwood-oncall handoff` and @notify the rotation. :bell:

mira: low-key poll — want a mini 'desk jungle' showcase? react with :seedling: if yes.

alex: :seedling: here's a quick collage of the chaos and the photobomb: https://imgur.com/gallery/abcd9876

sasha: 10/10 would attend plant-friendly standup. sending spare ethernet if you're in SF — DM incoming.

jamal: remote desk tour on Friday? meme idea: rate our desks by how many plants almost knocked over the router 😂

mira: vote: Friday 3pm? :calendar:

alex: 3pm works for me. thanks for the offers and tips — saved me from an emergency router purchase. :heart:

oliver: also pro tip: label your power strips. apparently my plant is named "off switch" now. :potted_plant:
